main_text.p: dignitas & forma viri. Quare etiam Carthagi‐nẽsi Synodo eam radere clerici vetiti sunt, quod Synodi caput corruperunt perfidiosisimè postea Rom. pontifices in Decretal. epist. Tit. De vita & honestate clericorum, & Agathensi concilio cap. 20. iidem clerici comâ promittere, vel alere prohibentur: id quod etiam extat in Can. clerici distinct. 23. in Decret. Duo vero hæreticorum superiorum genera his nostris adueꝛsa‐bantur: Prodiciani à Prodico vetusto nebulo‐ne profecti, qui Deum omnino precandum esse negarunt, vt scribit Clemens Alexandrinus Strom. libro 7. & Audiani, qui Monachos otiosos & nihil operantes, quales ifti suos esse volunt, vti ἀπρακτους homines, & excommunicandos prorsus reiiciunt & damnant. Ita diabolus sibi ipsi contrarius est, & serpens serpentem necat.

3 Tantum enim orant. Fuerunt multiplicia istius erroris capita. 1 Deum vnum quidem colunt, velut numen quoddam singulare, & monarchicum, nō autem quale nobis à diuina Scriptura proponitur in tres distinctum personas, & τρισσὰ reipsa existentes. Id quod ex Sabellianorum putido & exoleto iam errore sumptū est. Epiphanius. Inde Deitæ nostri seculi nati, & qui olim Monarchici dicti sunt, hoc caput amplectuntur. 2 Deum corporeis oculis cerni & videri posse contendunt. Nam eius naturam sub sensus nostros cadere volunt, quod ex Anthropomorphitarum errore ab iis sumptum & interpolatum est, contra manifestissima Christi vocem, Ioann. 1. vers. 16. Nam quod ait Christus ipse

page.notes: Pages/headers: the printed running head reads "Cap.57." at left and "AVGVSTINVS" at centre. Catchword "ipse" at the foot right. Doubtful readings: "eam radere" (possibly "eam radere"), "Strom.libro 7." and the Greek words "ἀπρακτους" and "τρισσὰ" are rendered from a faint scan and should be checked against the original; the Greek of "vti" and "reipsa" is partly illegible. The text "Tantum enim orant." is an italic running heading-like phrase in the body and is kept as printed. Scan is faint, show-through from the reverse page is visible in the lower half and was ignored.
